Transparent outer parts? Keep the MTL and texture files with your OBJ.

From Studio to an icon

  1. Select your complete model in Roblox Studio, including outer parts.
  2. Right click → Save / Export → Export as .obj (or Export Selection, depending on your Studio version).
  3. Save into a new empty folder.
  4. Choose that folder here, or drop every exported file together: OBJ + MTL + images.
  5. Adjust the preview. Click a model to inspect its materials. Download a PNG or use Download All ZIP.

Decals on invisible parts

Leave Preserve transparent decals and Render both sides on. You can set a material to Decal (texture alpha) to use its image transparency independently of the part opacity. Imported keeps the original material opacity; Hidden removes an unwanted shell.

If a texture is missing, select it in the material panel. If Studio did not export the outer face or decal at all, a website cannot recover it from the OBJ: export that geometry and its texture too. Do not change your original model just to test an export.

Everything renders locally. No model uploads, accounts, Python, or server processing required. Settings are remembered in this browser; model files are not.
